p1.p: Do clips lose quality when exported?
p1.r: No. The video you upload is stored without recompressing it, and every clip is built from that original, in 1080p at its own frame rate. If a zoom enlarges the image too much, the quality check warns you.

p2.p: What happens to clips over 90 seconds on Facebook?
p2.r: Facebook Reels go up to 90 seconds. For those clips you choose which part goes to Facebook, and the other networks get the full clip.

p3.p: Can I see how it looks on each network before posting?
p3.r: Yes. The preview overlays the TikTok, Reels, Shorts or Facebook interface, so you see whether a caption or text gets covered.
